final: WITH r AS (SELECT e.type AS type, b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount AS ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event), g AS (SELECT type, AVG(ratio) AS gavg FROM r GROUP BY type), o AS (SELECT AVG(gavg) AS oavg FROM g) SELECT g.type, g.gavg, g.gavg - o.oavg AS diff_from_overall FROM g CROSS JOIN o ORDER BY g.type
